product_one_liner.value: BombBomb helps relationship-driven sales teams create, send and track personalized video messages to strengthen customer relationships and improve engagement.

named_customers.notes: Both appear on the company's logo wall.

employee_band.notes: LeadIQ estimates approximately 71 employees as of October 2026.

eng_blog.notes: Historical developer-blog evidence: engineering leader Patrick McDavid republished two BombBomb Developer Blog posts covering CloudFront/TravisCI infrastructure and technical hackathon projects. Current publication activity was not established.

public_docs.notes: Public developer resources cover account setup, OAuth, integration, webhooks and APIs; the help center also contains multiple product articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The company job board states that there are no open positions.

model_provider.notes: No named model or provider was identified in the AI documentation, security FAQs, privacy policy or AI-related blog content reviewed. No public subprocessor list naming an AI provider was located.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims SOC 2 Type 2 certification and GDPR compliance; GDPR is a regulatory compliance claim, not a certification.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook lists the latest completed round as $2.43 million on March 12, 2025.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest listed round, March 12, 2025, predates the requested window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The company job board states that there are no open positions.

launched_6mo.notes: The New BombBomb Experience announcement has article metadata dated October 22, 2026 and specifies a November 9 rollout. It introduces browser-native screen recording, recording recovery after connection loss and searchable transcripts.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The profile lists a March 2026 start for the Vice President of Growth role at BombBomb, within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These are documented product integrations, not confirmation that BombBomb uses each system internally.
